text: {"status":"NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT","core_findings":["Electronics has the weakest sampled training-pair separation: negatives outrank positives in 16.04% of pairs, versus 5.66% for Industrial_and_Scientific and below 0.5% for Movies_and_TV and CDs_and_Vinyl.
